name: SmsTemplate
description: Per-app SMS template (plan-62.A). One row per (tenantId, name); body carries the renderable text. Source of truth is Trillo AI (TrilloMD row with modelClassName="SmsTemplate"); AOS is a read-only consumer that the deploy populates via DeployAppMetadata.bootstrapSmsTemplates (upsert by name). Mirrors EmailTemplate, minus subject/isHtml (SMS is plain text). dataApi: open with admin read-only ACL enforces 'no management UI on AOS' — admin can read via /data/SmsTemplate/* but generic create/update/delete are blocked. Edits happen in Trillo AI, ship via redeploy.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Template lookup key. Conventional names: mfaOtp, verifyPhone, genericNotice. App-custom templates use any unique-per-tenant name (e.g., 'order_shipped'). Composite unique constraint on (tenantId, name) enforced at the application layer.

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: SMS message text (plain text). Variables are {{{var}}} simple-replace placeholders rendered at send time. Keep short — each 160-char GSM-7 segment is billed separately.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Admin-facing description of when this template fires. Optional.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Discriminator. 'system' templates are the standard set (mfaOtp / verifyPhone / genericNotice) deployed from Trillo AI's starter content. 'app-custom' templates are app-specific flows the developer added in Trillo AI. Both deploy identically; the discriminator helps UIs filter and reset.
